request_profile.goal: Find reported bypass and compensatory routes around target X while preserving small and negative studies.

lanes.name: direct
lanes.trigger: The user asks for evidence about target X.
lanes.objective: Retrieve direct evidence about inhibition of target X.
lanes.completion_condition: Direct effects and contexts are represented.
lanes.residual_risk: Direct studies may omit adaptation over time.

lanes.name: topology
lanes.trigger: The request explicitly asks for bypass and compensation.
lanes.objective: Map alternative and adaptive routes around target X.
lanes.completion_condition: Material bypass and compensation edges have context and provenance.
lanes.residual_risk: Curated edges may not be experimentally independent.

lanes.name: contradiction
lanes.trigger: Negative and conflicting outcomes are decision-relevant.
lanes.objective: Find null, contradictory, corrected, and failed replication evidence.
lanes.completion_condition: At least one adversarial query family is executed.
lanes.residual_risk: Unpublished null results may remain unavailable.

lanes.name: long-tail
lanes.trigger: The user explicitly asks to preserve small studies.
lanes.objective: Retrieve small, early, gray, and non-mainstream evidence without pre-filtering by scale.
lanes.completion_condition: Selected long-tail classes are searched or marked blocked.
lanes.residual_risk: Methods and independence may be incompletely reported.

query_blocks.objective: Find direct perturbation evidence for target X.
Find bypass, compensation, redundancy, or feedback around target X.
Find null or conflicting perturbation outcomes.
Find small studies and gray records concerning target X adaptation.

stop_rules.sentinel_recovery: Recover known direct and bypass sentinel records when available.
stop_rules.marginal_yield: A new round adds no material independent evidence group or relation class.
stop_rules.coverage: All must-preserve items map to executed or explicitly blocked query blocks.
stop_rules.contradictions: Material conflicts are explained or retained as unresolved.
stop_rules.provenance: All decision-relevant records have identifiers, versions, retrieval dates, and query block IDs.

assumptions: Target X will be replaced by its canonical identifier and aliases before execution.
